given: a Staff Member whose role, shipped or composed by the Organization, holds front_desk.check_in or front_desk.check_out
then: the front-desk focus leads: arrivals and departures first; the role's name plays no part, so a custom role gets the same screen as the shipped one

given: a role holding housekeeping.update_status and finance.manage_folio but no front-desk permission
then: housekeeping leads; any balance they may see reaches attention, and the money figures stay the finance focus's own, because the shipped Front desk role holds finance.manage_folio and a literal union would put the Folio card on every front desk. Precedence is manager, front desk, housekeeping, finance

given: a Staff Member without finance.manage_folio, such as the shipped Housekeeping role
when: the summary is read for them
then: it carries no balance, no amount and no 'leaves owing' item: the server leaves them out, so nothing is hidden in the page that devtools could show

given: a Property without the housekeeping capability, or without billing
then: the cards for that module are absent, not zero and not greyed out; the rest of the page is unchanged

given: a Property in another Organization, or one the Staff Member is not assigned to
when: its id is sent to the summary route
then: the answer is the same empty summary a nonexistent Property gets; nothing distinguishes the two

given: a property parameter that is not a uuid
then: it answers an empty summary rather than a 500, as the arrivals route does

given: a request with no session or an ended one
then: it answers 401 with no body, never a redirect a polling screen would parse as data

given: a ?property= naming no Property the viewer has Today at
then: it redirects to /today, which then writes the Property it opens on into the URL (OA-S3-01), rather than showing the first Property's day under a switcher naming none
test_name: today.spec.ts: a Property named in the URL that Today does not reach goes back to Today on the Property it opens on

given: a Property whose business date cutoff (04:00 by default) has not yet passed
then: every figure is for the working day, which is still yesterday; the heading names the working day and says the clock has moved on (ADR 0021)

given: Reservations starting on the business date, some checked in, some confirmed, some cancelled or no-show
then: 'checked in of expected' counts checked-in and still-to-come; cancelled and no-show are in neither number

given: a check-in withdrawn with a reason (ADR 0022), so its Reservation is confirmed again
then: the Guest counts as still to arrive, not as checked in

given: Stays due to leave on the business date, some departed, one due yesterday and still in house
then: 'out of due' counts today's due Stays still here and every Stay checked out today — a check-out records the day it happened, so early leavers and formerly overdue Guests count as gone today; those still here past their date are counted separately as overdue and appear in attention

situation: Arrival into a room not ready
given: an arrival still to come whose room housekeeping has not made ready
then: it is an attention item naming the room, and the Guest for a viewer who works with Guests, opening Arrivals; for a viewer whose work is the room it opens the housekeeping board instead. Opening at the booking itself is slice 2

given: a Stay in house past its planned departure
then: it is an attention item naming the room, the Guest and the day they were due, opening Departures

given: a Stay due out today or overdue whose Folio balance is above zero, and a viewer holding finance.manage_folio
then: a Guest due out today with a balance is an attention item carrying the amount in the Property's currency, opening that Folio; one who is also overdue is the single overdue item carrying the amount and opens Departures (TD-S1-14). The word is balance, never unpaid, because payments are not recorded

situation: An arrival that cannot be checked in
given: an arrival whose check-in has a blocker, such as a bed still occupied
then: it is an attention item stating the blocker, opening Arrivals

given: a room, or a single bed in a room that is otherwise let, out of service; a blocked unit is not one
when: the summary is read by a viewer with the housekeeping or front-desk focus
then: it is an attention item naming the room, or the bed and its room, opening the housekeeping board, or Rooms where there is none; a blocked unit is a decision with a reason and is not listed. Read from the unit map, so it needs the front desk capability; a Property with housekeeping and no front desk lists none

given: more attention items than fit one row
then: items are ordered by what the viewer's focus does first (TD-S8-03); the first four places show the first item of each kind in that order and then fill in order, and the rest are one 'N more' item, so one long run of one kind never hides the others

given: no item of any kind
then: one calm line says so; the row does not disappear, so its absence is never mistaken for a failure

given: sellable units, Stays in house, arrivals still to come and departures still due
then: occupancy is in-house over sellable; 'expected tonight' is the rooms held once the day is over, counted of the rooms that can be let (sellable less blocked and out of service) and said in the tile as 'N / M available rooms': in house, less the Guests who go today (an overdue Guest does not go: ADR 0033 holds their room until somebody checks them out), plus the arrivals that put a Guest in a room of their own (a request nobody confirmed, a blocked or out-of-order room, and a room whose occupant stays on hold none); with no available room neither is a percentage and the tile says there are no units to let

given: dirty rooms, some with an arrival today, some whose Guest leaves today, some neither
then: rooms with an arrival today come first, then clean rooms awaiting inspection with an arrival, then rooms still occupied by a Guest leaving today, then the rest by how long they have been dirty

situation: Every figure is a way in
given: any tile, attention item or row
then: it lands on the list that explains it, carrying ?property= so the Property does not change, as a client navigation like the rail's; narrowed to exactly the rows the figure counted where it counts part of a list, through ?show= or ?floor= (TD-S5-01), and by ?folio= for one Folio

given: a Property with no arrivals and no departures today
then: the figures read zero where they always are; the movements card is an empty state that says so and offers Reservations

given: one module's read fails while the others answer
then: that section is marked unavailable and the failure is logged on the server; the others are unaffected and the card offers a retry

given: a later refresh of the summary fails
then: the last numbers stay, and the freshness line says they are from their time rather than now

given: another Staff Member checks a Guest in at another desk
then: the figures follow within 60 seconds, and at once on focus or after this viewer's own action; the dashboard only reads, so nothing conflicts

given: Turkish, English or Arabic
then: all copy is in that language, numbers, dates and money are formatted by it, and Arabic mirrors by logical utilities alone

given: a viewport below md
then: attention comes first, then the figures two across, then the focus's list: a figure that sits below a long list is not read, and the audit found them 2,900 px down; nothing scrolls sideways
test_name: today.spec.ts: on a phone Today leads with the task and never scrolls sideways

given: a Staff Member with memberships in two Organizations
when: Today is opened at a Property of one
then: every figure and permission is that Organization's; nothing from the other appears

given: a Staff Member with Today at a Property but no module whose cards they may see
then: the working day and clock show, and one line says there is nothing here for their role yet, rather than an empty grid

given: a Staff Member
then: it greets them by display name, falling back to the part of their email before the @, never the full address

given: an arrival row and a viewer holding front_desk.check_in
when: they check the Guest in from the row
then: it is the Arrivals dialog and command, unchanged, including the not-ready warning; the figures refresh at once
test_name: today.spec.ts: check in from Today is the arrivals command, warning included

given: a departure row and a viewer holding front_desk.check_out
when: they check the Guest out from the row
then: it is the Departures dialog and command, unchanged, including the balance review and reason
test_name: today.spec.ts: check out from Today is the departures command, balance review included

given: a clean-first row and a viewer holding housekeeping.update_status
when: they mark the room clean or inspected
then: it is the board's command, unchanged; a room with a Guest still in it offers no action and says why
test_name: today.spec.ts: mark from Today is the board command, and an occupied room is not marked

given: a row and a viewer without the command's permission
then: the row offers no action, only the way in; the command would refuse anyway
test_name: today.spec.ts: no action is offered without its permission

given: an attention item or a row naming one booking or Stay
then: deferred: the list opens at the Property, not at the booking or Stay, until the lists take an id to open at; none does yet

given: a viewer holding audit.read
when: Today renders with the manager focus
then: the five newest audit records they may read since the start of yesterday on the Property's clock appear, each naming what it is about (a Guest and room, a person) and who did it as a colleague says it, with no address, and opening that record; with none the card says nothing has been recorded since yesterday; without audit.read the card is absent

given: a viewer holding finance.manage_folio
then: charges less reversals posted on the business date appear as one figure opening Finance

given: a viewer who reaches more than one Property
then: a strip names each with its occupancy and attention count; choosing one is a full load, like the switcher (ADR 0019); with one Property the strip is absent
test_name: today.spec.ts: the Organization strip shows only with several Properties, and choosing one is a full load

given: Reservations and Stays over the next 14 days
when: Today renders with the manager focus
then: a line of booked occupancy per day, with a visually hidden table of the same values; it is bookings, not a forecast model

given: blueprint 18.4 lists unresolved requests
then: deferred for a hotel: no requests module existed when this was written, and a dormitory's Today now draws the card (TD-S10-04); a hotel's Today has none until a hotel asks for it

given: blueprint 18.4 lists maintenance blockers
then: superseded by TD-S4-01 to TD-S4-06

given: blueprint 18.4 lists shift handover notes
then: deferred: no handover notes exist; closing the day (#72) closes a business date and records no notes

given: blueprint 18.4 lists them
then: deferred: none of the modules exists

given: a revenue snapshot
then: deferred: room nights are now charged at the close (ADR 0038), so revenue is no longer invented; a revenue tile is its own slice, and S3's charges posted today stays the honest figure until it is designed

given: blueprint 20.7 item 10
then: deferred: positions are fixed per focus for muscle memory until saved views exist

given: a Guest still in house after the Property's check-out time
then: deferred: no Property has a check-out time; overdue means an earlier day until one does

given: a role holding only maintenance permissions and none of front desk, housekeeping, finance or manager
then: deferred: such a role leads nowhere (TD-S1-30), so nothing of maintenance is read for it; a maintenance focus is designed when a shipped role needs one

given: an attention item or figure naming one request
then: deferred: the maintenance board has no id to open at; it opens the board at the Property until it does

given: the maintenance card's open, new, in progress and waiting for parts figures
then: proposed to defer: the maintenance board has no status filter, so these four open the board unfiltered at the Property while the rooms card narrows; the board needs ?show= for its statuses (the maintenance feature) before they can open exactly what they count, as TD-S5-01 asks of every other figure. The out-of-order figure no longer waits: the board filters by held rooms (TD-S4-07)

given: a maintenance request of priority urgent, not done or cancelled, at the Property, and a viewer holding maintenance.report or maintenance.manage
then: it is an attention item naming its number and title and the room or equipment it concerns, opening the maintenance board; a viewer without either permission is not shown it

situation: Out of order past its return
given: a room held out of order by a request whose expected return date is before the business date
then: it is an attention item saying the room was due back on that date, opening the maintenance board, and it replaces the plain out-of-service item for that room: the earliest-due hold when several requests hold the room; an urgent request that holds its room absorbs that room's other hold items and shows only its own due-back date, or none — while an urgent repair holds the room it is not coming back anyway; an urgent request about a room it does not hold is listed next to that room's own hold item; due back on the business date is not yet past

given: a room out of service because a maintenance request holds it, and a viewer holding a maintenance permission
then: the out-of-service item (TD-S1-17) names the request and opens the maintenance board instead of the housekeeping board; a viewer without a maintenance permission keeps TD-S1-17 as it is

given: the manager focus, the maintenance capability on, and a maintenance permission held
then: a card shows open requests (new, in progress, waiting for parts) and rooms out of order, each figure opening the maintenance board with ?property=; done and cancelled are not counted, and out of order counts distinct Units, beds included, however many requests hold each, as the board it opens does (MT-S2-32)

given: the maintenance capability off at the Property
then: no maintenance card and no maintenance attention items; TD-S1-17 is unchanged

given: the maintenance read fails while the rest of Today reads
then: the maintenance card is unavailable with a retry and the attention list is marked incomplete (TD-S1-24); nothing else is withheld

situation: A figure counts part of a list
given: a figure on Today that counts a subset of the list it opens: arrivals still to come, Guests leaving with a balance, overdue departures with a balance, rooms in service, ready, awaiting inspection, dirty, out of service, rooms an arrival waits on, rooms to clean first, the rooms on a floor, or open Folios
then: the list opens narrowed through ?show= (?floor= for a floor) to exactly the rows the figure counted, says so with how many and what, and offers the whole list again; Today and the list ask the same predicate, so a figure is the length of the list it opens, never a second definition that drifts

given: Guests already checked out today, as the first half of 'checked out 1 / 3'
then: Departures opens with who is still to go and, under it, who has left today, read by listDepartedToday from the same query that counts them; the figure is the length of that list, which the departures list alone cannot show because it lists who is still here

given: arrivals still to come, some in a room housekeeping has made ready, some not, and one that cannot be checked in
then: 'ready of to come' counts the arrivals list's own rows: ready is rows whose room the list calls ready, the sub-line is rows it calls not ready, and a row that cannot be checked in is in neither (the list says why); the figure opens arrivals still to come. For housekeeping, 'arrivals waiting on a room' counts the rooms an arrival today waits on, and opens exactly those rooms

given: ?show= or ?floor= naming nothing Today offers
then: the whole list, no error and no empty page, as an unknown ?property= already goes back to a Property that exists

situation: A number that is not a way in
given: any number on Today that is not inside a link or a control
then: only the Property's clock, the working day, the freshness line and the count of attention items are unlinked, and each says what it counts beside the list that holds it; a figure added to Today must open something or fail this test
test_name: today.spec.ts: every number on Today is a way in, or says what it counts

given: a figure that is zero, one or many, in Turkish, English or Arabic
then: the list opens and its notice reads the language's own plural form for the count, including Arabic's two and zero; zero opens the list's empty state, not an error
test_name: today.spec.ts: a count of one and a count of many read right in every language

given: a Property with no Units, no bookings and nobody in house
when: Today is opened and every figure followed
then: every figure reads zero and opens its list, which says there is nothing there; the attention row says nothing needs attention rather than disappearing
test_name: today.spec.ts: on a quiet day every figure reads zero and still opens its list

situation: Charges today beside the money figures
given: a viewer holding finance.manage_folio whose focus is the front desk, housekeeping or none
then: charges today appears with the manager and finance focuses only, where the other money figures are (TD-S1-02): the shipped Front desk role holds finance.manage_folio and a literal reading of TD-S3-02 would put a money card on every front desk

given: the Guest Services module and its Guest Experience screen now exist (TD-DEF-01 waited for them), a Property has the guest_experience capability, and a viewer holds guest_services.create_request or guest_services.manage_requests
then: proposed, not built: a card counts requests that are new or in progress and opens the Guest Experience screen at the Property; an urgent request that is not resolved is an attention item opening that screen; the card is absent where the capability is off or the permission is not held, and is not a focus of its own (TD-DEF-08). Replaces TD-DEF-01 once approved

given: a Property with a Guest in house ten days past their date, one Guest leaving today, an arrival, an arrival into a blocked room and a room out of order
when: Today and the room calendar are both read
then: the tile's 'expected tonight' and the first night of 'booked ahead' are the same rooms of the same rooms: the overdue Guest holds theirs, the Guest leaving does not, the blocked room holds nothing and the out-of-order room is not counted; the tile says 'N / M available rooms' so a different denominator never reads as a different truth
test_name: tonight_is_one_number: expected tonight is the calendar's first night, counted of the same rooms

situation: Ready means a Guest can be put in it
given: a room housekeeping calls ready that has a Guest in it
then: a room is counted ready only when nobody is in it: the tile, the rooms card, each floor and the board narrowed by ?show=ready all ask the same predicate, so the number is the length of the list it opens

situation: An overdue departure is days, not a date
given: a Stay in house past its planned departure
when: Today renders at the front desk or the manager focus
then: the departures tile says '1 to leave, overdue N days' (the longest, when there are several) in the danger colour, the row says 'Overdue · N days', and the attention card says 'N days overdue · was due to leave on <date>', N counted on the Property's business date; the headline 'out of due' keeps TD-S1-12's meaning

situation: A room not ready says why
given: an arrival into a room that is not ready, and a board that says it is dirty, clean and waiting for inspection, occupied, or blocked or out of order
when: Today renders for the desk or for housekeeping
then: the card says which in its sentence; a viewer who may mark rooms is sent to the board narrowed to the rooms an arrival waits on, one who may not to the arrivals; housekeeping is not told a second time about a room the clean-first queue lists, only about a room no cleaning can ready

given: a tab whose browser has gone offline, so a refresh is held back rather than failed
when: the interval passes or the connection drops
then: the freshness line becomes the same warning pill as a failed refresh and says when the figures are from; coming back online refreshes them and clears it
test_name: today-ux.spec.ts: a tab that goes offline says its figures are old, without waiting for a refresh to fail

given: the movements card
when: it is read by a screen reader or driven by a keyboard
then: the switch is a tablist with the selected tab in the tab order, the arrow keys moving between the two, and a tab panel named by the tab shown
test_name: today-ux.spec.ts: arrivals and departures are tabs, and the arrow keys move between them

situation: A fraction and a zone read in the reader's language
given: Today in Arabic, and any Property in a time zone
then: a figure of a whole is written with the word for "of" in Arabic, where a slash between two numerals reads in either order; the time zone is named in the reader's language and not spelled as its identifier
test_name: today-ux.spec.ts: in Arabic a fraction is read with a word, and the overdue count with its days

situation: The booked-ahead line can be read
given: fourteen nights of booked occupancy
when: the line is looked at, pointed at or focused
then: each night has a day tick under it, and pointing at the line or moving along it with the arrow keys says that night's date, rooms and share; the hidden table still carries every value
test_name: today-ux.spec.ts: the booked-ahead line has day ticks and says a night's figure where it is pointed at

situation: Two tiles never share a name
given: a front desk with arrivals checked in and rooms ready for waiting arrivals, or a housekeeper with rooms ready and arrivals waiting on a room
then: each tile names the list it opens by what it counts: the second is "Arrival rooms", so two identical titles over two different numbers cannot read as one figure shown twice

situation: Tonight in Analytics is Today's number
given: a Property with a blocked room, an out-of-order room, an overdue Guest and a Guest in house
when: Today's occupancy tile and Analytics' row for today are read
then: the rooms that can be let and the Guests in them are the same on both, so the percentage is the same; the month's row says it counts every day so far (RANZ-52, AN-S5-02)
test_name: tests/integration/today-ux.test.ts: tonight_is_one_number_in_the_month_table_too: the table's open day is Today's occupancy

situation: Days waiting to be closed are on Today
given: a Property whose last close is behind its business date, seen by the front desk or a manager
then: what needs attention leads with how many days wait to be closed and the oldest of them, counted by the same query as Close the day, and opens Close the day at the Property; it is never folded under "N more" and takes none of the four places a room's item has; nothing is listed once yesterday is closed, and housekeeping and finance are not asked (CLOSE-06)

situation: The out-of-order figure opens the held rooms
given: the maintenance card with rooms out of order
when: the rooms out of order figure is pressed
then: the board opens at the Property narrowed to the requests that hold a room (?outOfOrder=1); the status figures open it whole

situation: Dirty and awaiting inspection count empty rooms only
given: a dirty or clean-awaiting-inspection room with a Guest in it
when: any figure, floor or list of those states is read
then: the room is in house and counted in neither, on Today, the board and the layouts alike, so each number is the length of the list it opens; rooms a Guest is still leaving are cleaned last and counted apart (TODAY-03, TODAY-05)

situation: To clean says how many wait on a Guest
given: a housekeeper whose dirty rooms include some a Guest is leaving
then: To clean counts the rooms that can be cleaned now and its line says how many more are waiting for the Guest to leave; the clean-first list puts them last under a heading that says so (TODAY-05)

situation: What leads depends on the focus
given: the same attention items seen by the desk, by finance and by housekeeping
then: the desk leads with the Guests waiting, finance with what is owed and housekeeping with the rooms to get ready, and each ends with the other departments' items; a repair never leads a finance row (TODAY-06)

given: a finance viewer with open Folios
then: the open Folios and their balance are one tile, not two that open the same list under the same name; the departures tile says it is owed by Guests leaving or overdue (TODAY-17)

situation: Tonight says how an overdue Guest is counted
given: an overdue Guest in house
then: its line says overdue Guests are counted as staying until they are checked out, in the same words as the timeline (TODAY-01, TODAY-04)

situation: The finance tiles owe what Finance owes
given: a finance viewer with open Folios, some of whose nights no close has charged
when: the Open Folios tile and the largest balances are drawn
then: the tile says what is owed and how much of it is for nights check-out will charge, from the same function as Finance and Departures (FO-S11-01); the largest balances list the Folios that owe, by what each owes in all, and says so when none does (FINANCE-01)

given: a dormitory with Blok A (a women's room, one bed of two taken) and Blok B (a men's room, both beds free), rooms let by the bed
then: the Empty beds card reads building by building as well as for the whole house: Blok A 1 for women, Blok B 2 for men, with a row for rooms in no building last; the house row is the sum of the blocks, and a Property whose rooms name no building draws the house row alone (RB-S5-20 as it was). situation: A block's figure opens the beds it counts
given: the Empty beds card by block
then: Rooms opens at /rooms?show=free&admits=<gender>&block=<building>, narrowed to that building's free places for that gender, and its notice names the building and gives the same number back with a way to the whole map; rooms in no building open as block=none and read "other rooms". Where the figure and the list could differ (a Staff Member in two Organizations, a block name the Property does not have) the list wins: an unknown block narrows nothing and the notice is absent rather than reading zero

situation: The Rooms block filter reads the same on every screen that opens it
given: the term board's Rooms link and Today's block figures
then: one address shape serves both: the building's name, none for no building, and nothing for the whole house; it is a narrowing of the list, never a permission, so a Staff Member sees only the Properties and rows they could see without it (ADR 0057: no rule reads the operating model)

situation: Open requests and maintenance at a dormitory
given: a dormitory with two open Student requests (one urgent) and one open maintenance request, and a manager who holds the guest-experience capability and may read requests
then: one card Requests and maintenance shows how many requests are open (and how many of those urgent), how many maintenance requests are open and how many rooms are out of order; each figure opens its own list at the same Property. A figure the viewer may not see is left out rather than drawn as zero; a read that failed is a retry in the reader's words, never a confident zero; a Property without the capability asks for no read at all

situation: The open work card replaces the hotel's maintenance card
given: a dormitory whose manager holds maintenance
then: maintenance is said once: the open work card carries the open and out-of-order counts the hotel's Maintenance card carried, so no number is drawn twice under two names; a hotel keeps its own Maintenance card and never gets the new one

situation: Arrivals and departures only when there are any
given: a dormitory whose day has nobody arriving, nobody due to leave and nobody overdue
when: Today is drawn on the timeline or the overview
then: no Checked in or Checked out figure, no Today's flow and no 0/0 card; the moment one Student is due to arrive or leave, or is overdue, the figure and the flow come back. A section that could not be read is a retry, never quiet. A hotel with the same empty day still draws every one of them

situation: Rooms ready to sell is beds where rooms are let by the bed
given: a dormitory whose rooms are let by the bed
